description: A PGLite owner SIGKILLed inside a withdrawal's publication effect (after its side effect, before completion) left the effect claimed for its 2-minute lease; the restarted owner neither ran the effect nor published writes to the withdrawn page until the lease expired. Fixed by releaseAbandonedClaims (src/core/persistence/effect-journal.ts). Found at effect:withdrawal-mirror:mid; since G4 wave 2 a forget publishes through Git, so the kill lands at the forget's Git effect (effect:git:mid #3: put, remember, forget). Re-proved 3/3 (wedge) with releaseAbandonedClaims removed.
